body:
I've been taking Adderall for about 3 years but recently my doctors switched me to Vyvanse which SUCKED. I went insane, I missed my Adderall soo much. I craved it, needed it.  Even though Adderall made me crazy when I took it, I felt like titanium. I was invincible on it. But it made me stop thinking like actually thinking I was a zombie. But inside I felt great.
Almost a week ago my doctors put me back on Adderall I was soo happy. It's crazy what it does to me. It controls me literally. But the feeling on being on it is better then anything.
I took about 400mgs of Adderall at once and legit almost died it was so SCARY!
LOVE THE SHIT THOUGH <3
[Reported Dose: '40mgs-70mgs']
